attacks.target: S3 — 执行 quintic 上的 continuous-time conformal-Bernstein 碰撞风险证书 P(撞或误分)<=ε,vs 检测到并分类的 agent
attacks.attack_summary: 最有杀伤力是攻击3(边际 vs 部署语义),两条边都命中但都不致命。3a 条件覆盖:Lemma 5 的 P(S_i>q̂)<=α 是 split-conformal 的【边际】概率(在 标定集抽取 × 可交换测试未来 的联合空间取平均)。一架真部署、标定集冻死不再重抽的无人机,真正可操作的对象是【给定我这套标定集的条件误覆盖】P(S_i>q̂|D_cal)——它随标定集抽取 Beta 波动、均值<=α 但单实例可显著 >α(经典结果)。headline「保证 P(撞该人)<=0.1」若被 RA-L 审稿/安全认证方按【这台部署系统的长期碰撞频率】来读(这正是他们会读的方式),则【未被建立】:边际界只保证"对从不会去做的标定重抽平均后 <=ε"。这是 headline 语义错位,不是 S3 数学错。3b 每回合→每架次复利:claim 已诚实限定「每个规划回合」,但 sup-score 只收掉【单个 commit 的 horizon 内】时间轴 union,跨 commit 重规划是【真实、未塌缩】的 union。一次 ~60s/0.75s≈80 个 commit,若各回合独立则 per-flight 上界 ≈1-0.9^80→近乎必撞,使 per-round 0.1 作为安全陈述近乎空洞。防御只能靠(正相关 + 人=硬约束承载真正人身安全 + persistent-feasibility),不能靠 S3 本身。defense-map 已自认此伤(「fast-replan 稀释证书 致命度4」)。附:可交换性 A3(反应式/闭环行人使 x_i 依赖 τ,破 A1/A6)会从另一侧吃掉 Lemma 5,但那是独立、已在 A6 自曝的伤,非本三向量。
attacks.what_breaks:
逐向量判定(被要求往死里打的三条):
攻击1(sup-over-horizon 偷漏连续时间 union?)= MISS,如实承认打不动,这是 S3 最硬的一块。S_i=sup_t|x_i-x̂_i|/ρ_i 是【单个标量泛函】;{S_i<=q̂}={∀t 误差<=r_i} 是恒等式,不是 union。把同一 sup 泛函作用到可交换整条轨迹保持可交换 ⇒ 标量 conformal 给 P(S_i>q̂)<=α,时间轴在概率侧【真被预付】。几何侧 Lemma 4 对【多项式/CA 预测】的 exact-deficit 是 Bernstein 连续时间凸包包络(非采样):all b_k<=0 ⇒ f(s)<=0 ∀s∈[0,1],也无时间 union;多段是有限 AND(确定性)。Lemma 6 reverse-triangle + certify 未来独立(A1) 避开 conditioning fallacy。单 commit 内【没有】被偷漏的连续时间 union;唯一未塌缩的是跨 commit(=攻击3b)。结论:此向量如实 miss。
攻击2(学习型非多项式预测的保守多项式包络不可构造/tube 爆炸到无用)= LANDS 但仅作 scope/框架纠正,不致命,且【证伪了"致命则 S3 只能限 CA"这一前提】。关键洞见:证书只读 x̂_i 与 r_i(二者都是设计者可控的),网络的非多项式性对证书【不可见】。正确构造不是 dossier 的 Case B「给网络套多项式包络」(那个 L 要么 L≡0 退化空洞、要么逐点间未定义而 ill-posed,是伪路径),而是:(i) 把网络输出的离散 waypoint 用低次多项式【插值】定义 x̂_i:=interpolant(免费);(ii) 把归一化 ρ_i【选成】多项式(纯设计自由,conformal 有效性对 ρ_i 形状无要求、只影响紧度);(iii) 对真值-vs-插值的 sup 残差做 conformal 标定。于是【完全回到 Case A】,exact-deficit 连续时间证明原样成立。故 S3 的 soundness 对学习型预测器照样成立、不必限 CA。真正会"爆炸"的只是 tube 宽度(多模态行人/标定不准的学习预测器),但那攻【可用性】(tube 太宽→无可行轨迹→RTA),【不攻 soundness】(胖 tube 仍 trivially 含真值,P(撞)<=ε 照样成立),且已被 W4 经验 gate(q95<=0.6-0.7m)拦截、未当定理声明。唯一真 soundness 子条件:标定对象必须 ≡ 证书所用多项式对象(interpolant discipline),否则 Lemma 6 三角不等式泄。
攻击3 = 唯一真正 LANDS 的严重项(详见 attack_summary):断的是 P(撞)<=ε 的【部署语义读法】(边际 × 每回合),不是某一步数学。
attacks.is_fatal_or_scoped: 不致命 / 可降为 honest scope。三条都不迫使撤 claim:攻击1 miss;攻击2 仅框架纠正 + 可用性 caveat(且反证 S3 不必限 CA);攻击3 严重但可降为诚实 scope。P(撞)<=ε 作为【边际(跨标定抽取)、每个规划回合】的对象是真的(G7/A6 已自曝),无需撤回。只要求:(a) 把"边际 + 每回合"两个限定词从 §SEMANTICS 提升到 headline,别埋在脚注;(b) 若要 per-deployment 数字则加 PAC/training-conditional 膨胀。split-conformal 边际覆盖是全 CP 文献常规、且常规过审,所以 survivable 而非 fatal。注意红线:一旦摘要把限定词丢了、把 ε=0.1 当"这台系统的碰撞率"卖,攻击3 立即升级为必撤级 overclaim——所以这是写作纪律问题,不是定理问题。

attacks.target: STRIDE — the co-marquee "Safety ⊥ winding-enumeration completeness" firewall theorem (positioned in W4-kill #12 as "the one uncontested novel atom").
attacks.attack_summary: Attacks (1) and (3) are the same kill from two sides and they LAND; attack (2) MISSES on the math. THE KILL (novelty, not soundness): STRIDE's entire formal content is its own "WHAT IS AIRTIGHT" line — C(E)=T_enum(E)∩S_θ ⇒ C(E)⊆S_θ (Lemma 3). That is "set-intersection ⊆ one operand," true for ANY candidate set and ANY gate; "Safe(τ) independent of enumeration" is just "the gate B does not read the generator A in A∩B." This is verbatim the DEFINING guarantee of Run-Time Assurance / Simplex architecture (Sha 2001) / safety shielding (Alshiekh–Bloem 2018): a sound per-output monitor makes safety a function of the output alone, independent of how the (untrusted/arbitrary) primary produced it. The RTA literature states STRIDE's claim word-for-word: "RTA filters are decoupled from the primary controller... permits any type of controller to be used... without impacting the safety of the system." STRIDE = this with "untrusted primary = winding/homotopy enumeration." I code-confirmed the decoupling is REAL (DetourConfig reaches only generate_detour_seeds/make_detour_path/top-level plan_minco; the gate select_best_minco filters only on per-trajectory trajectory_valid) — which is exactly why it is NOT a theorem: it is the generic generate-and-test / safety-filter property, zero theorem-level novelty. ATTACK 1 (circular/trivial, "要么有解要么不飞") is the same point internally: STRIDE Lemma 5 itself concedes enumeration buys ONLY liveness + optimality, and the executed-map image A(E)∪{⊥}⊆S_θ∪{⊥} is satisfied vacuously by the constant-⊥ (always-RTA) map. So STRIDE claims the TRIVIAL half (safety = gate) and disclaims the HARD half (don't-always-abort = liveness), exactly the "either there's a solution or don't fly" reading. The conditional is not FALSE, but its content as a CONTRIBUTION is empty.
attacks.what_breaks: Nothing in STRIDE's math breaks — the decoupling (Lemmas 1–5) is sound and code-verified. What breaks is its NOVELTY/marquee status. The load-bearing "firewall" atom C(E)=T_enum∩S_θ⇒C(E)⊆S_θ (Lemma 3 / ASSEMBLY §8 / R3) is the generic safety-filter identity (RTA/Simplex/shielding decoupling), not a new result; Lemma 5's "completeness affects only optimality value + RTA trigger" confirms enumeration only ever bought liveness/optimality, so the safety-half STRIDE markets is the trivial half. ATTACK 2 separately MISSES: S3's exact scalar deficit f(s)=(r_i(t)+r_body)²−‖τ(s)−x̂_i(t(s))‖² is, for CA prediction (quadratic in t, t affine in s on a committed segment), a genuine degree-10 polynomial in the single variable s; Bernstein range enclosure p(s)∈[min b_k,max b_k] is exact ⇒ max b_k≤0 ⇒ f≤0 ∀s∈[0,1] is SOUND continuous-time regardless of obstacle motion. It does NOT collapse like the shipped halfspace, because it never linearizes the norm with a frozen shared direction — the halfspace (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:146-148, per-control-point a_k at distinct times) collapses precisely because the convex-hull step needs ONE shared direction a across all k and movers rotate the geometry; the deficit needs no direction. So the team's self-assessment ("S3 deficit holds for CA movers, halfspace doesn't") is CORRECT. The real residual that attack-2 exposes (already in remaining_gaps, not a fresh kill): the CA-sound deficit is UNIMPLEMENTED (grep: no degree-elevation/Bernstein-product/deficit code), the shipped closed cert is the non-continuous-time halfspace (telemetry-only, G2), and the OPERATIVE mover gate is dense sampling K≥200 (sound only to resolution/Lipschitz, with the Lipschitz bridge unstated) — so the SHIPPED firewall currently has no sound closed continuous-time mover certificate in the loop.
attacks.is_fatal_or_scoped: SPLIT. (a) The NOVELTY / co-marquee claim — "STRIDE is a novel firewall theorem," "the one uncontested novel atom" — is FATAL / must be retracted (claim 必撤): it is a textbook instance of RTA/Simplex/shielding (sound per-output monitor ⇒ safety independent of the untrusted generator's internals, incl. enumeration completeness), with the formal core being A∩B⊆B. No "firstness," no theorem-level novelty survives. (b) The decoupling FACT survives, DOWNGRADED to an honest one-line corollary/positioning note (an RTA-instance observation applied to homotopy-enumeration incompleteness) — not a marquee, not novel. (c) Attack-2's "CA deficit also collapses" sub-claim is a MISS — S3's CA-mover deficit math is sound; its weaknesses are implementation-gap + learned-predictor-envelope + float-soundness (all already conceded), not a continuous-time collapse. Why "serious" not "fatal-to-paper": no math is falsified and S3 (the genuine conformal-Bernstein per-trajectory certificate) is untouched — but STRIDE was the LAST-line novelty fallback if S2-A gets read as repackaged mp-NLP (Bemporad/Tøndel) and S3 is already "conjunction-only" vs CP-MPC+Bernstein. Killing STRIDE's novelty removes that fallback, so the paper's overall "we have a NOVEL safety-layer theorem" thesis is seriously wounded and now rests entirely on S3's conjunction + S2-A's semantic-triple surviving their own prior-art assassins.
attacks.repair_needed: NOT a soundness repair (math is fine) — a novelty/positioning retraction. Wave7 must: (1) RETRACT STRIDE as a co-marquee/novel "firewall theorem" and as "the one uncontested novel atom." Demote to a single honest sentence: "The safety layer is a runtime safety filter (Simplex/RTA/shielding); as in any such architecture, the per-trajectory certificate makes the flown-trajectory guarantee a function of (τ*,O,Θ) alone, so homotopy/winding-enumeration incompleteness costs only liveness/optimality (anytime/Pareto gap + possibly conservative RTA), never safety." Explicitly cite Sha 2001 Simplex, the RTA safety-filter survey (Hobbs et al. 2110.03506), Alshiekh–Bloem 2018 shielding, Black-box/Neural Simplex — and do NOT claim "first to decouple safety from enumeration" (that is the RTA definition). (2) Acknowledge the "要么有解要么不飞" decomposition openly: safety=trivial/filter half (known), liveness under incomplete enumeration=hard half (not claimed). (3) Move ALL novelty weight onto S3 (and S2-A's semantic triple). For S3: attack-2 confirms the CA-mover exact deficit is SOUND but UNIMPLEMENTED — either implement the exact deficit WITH outward-rounded interval/rational Bernstein arithmetic (for float-sign soundness) so the shipped mover guarantee is a closed continuous-time certificate, OR honestly scope the shipped mover guarantee to dense-sampling and SUPPLY the missing Lipschitz/sampling-resolution bridge; and construct the learned-predictor conservative polynomial envelope (or scope the headline to CA predictors). (4) Stop conflating S3's exact deficit (sound for CA movers) with the shipped per-control-point halfspace (G2, not continuous-time sound) — they are different objects and the paper must say which one carries the guarantee.

attacks.target: S2-A — "priced breakpoint structure" marquee core: a single conformal-priced scalar λ that simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent risk budget and (b) selects winding/passing-side, with λ-sweep breakpoints certified as homotopy switches (claim iii: "some agent i has σ_i flipped ⟹ breakpoint CERTIFIED as homotopy switch"). The only retained novelty per Wave5 = this conjunction.
attacks.attack_summary: The σ-lossy / mp-NLP-reskin INTERLOCK. σ_i = sign(net signed angle) is a doubly-lossy projection of the true invariant: it collapses winding NUMBER to a sign (loses +1 vs +2) and collapses the non-abelian braid (multi-agent crossing ORDER) to its abelianization (per-strand linking). So claim (iii) faces a dilemma with no escape: (i) if the breakpoint is certified via σ_i-flip, it is UNSOUND — a braid-order switch among ≥2 agents, or a winding-magnitude switch +1→+2 around one agent in a dense crowd, is a genuine homotopy change with ZERO σ_i flips (false negative: real switch missed, or worse mislabeled "numerical artifact" = unsound diagnosis), while two continuously-homotopic routes on the coarse NS=12/NT=48 lane-RCSP can get different discrete σ-sums near a station boundary (false positive: a non-switch certified AS a switch = literally "certified breakpoint ≠ true homotopy switch"); (ii) if instead it is rescued by the FULL Bhattacharya H-signature/winding-number, then it is exactly T-MPC++ (2401.06021), which already compares homotopy classes among pedestrians via "H-signature, winding numbers and UVD." There is NO configuration that is both sound AND novel. Then the reskin charge lands fully: breakpoint/critical-region structure = Bemporad/Tøndel mp-QP + 2604.07693 (authors already concede textbook); price→maneuver-switch+risk Pareto = Dual CC-SSP 2302.13115; per-agent budget reallocation Σα_i≤ε = IRA/H-PRAP; conformal radius = CP-MPC (Lindemann/Dixit/IA-CP 2502.06221). The SOLE remaining glue — "one λ does BOTH reallocation AND selection" — is hollow: strong-duality water-filling (S2-B) is already FALSIFIED (nonconvex, no strong duality), and under bottleneck (max-)risk the reallocation degenerates to a single binding agent with zero shadow price on the rest (needs state augmentation per Wave5 G5), so the reallocation half is uncertified in the additive regime and empty in the bottleneck regime — it is never simultaneously non-trivial AND sound. Finally, by the authors' own STRIDE firewall, S2-A is NOT safety-load-bearing (safety rides on per-candidate S3). Net: S2-A = textbook parametric-RCSP critical regions + a lossy non-novel topology label + conformal units, carrying no certified, load-bearing, novel content.
attacks.what_breaks: Claim (iii) breaks at two steps. STEP 1 (the certification): "at each topological breakpoint λ_k some agent i has σ_i flipped ⟹ the breakpoint is CERTIFIED as a homotopy switch" is false as written — σ_i (a sign) is not the homotopy invariant. Counterexamples: (C1, false-neg) drone winds +1 around agents A and B but switches their crossing ORDER (braid generator change) — genuine homotopy switch, identical σ_A=σ_B=+ before/after, NO σ flip; (C2, false-neg) winding magnitude +1→+2 around one agent in a dense loop — switch, same sign, no flip; (C3, false-pos) two continuously-homotopic lane-RCSP routes get different discrete σ-sums → a non-switch certified as a switch. If patched to the full H-signature, the step is sound but is verbatim T-MPC++ (no novelty). STEP 2 (the unification): "the SAME scalar λ is simultaneously the budget shadow price AND the winding selector" breaks because (a) the dual identity that would make λ a genuine joint optimizer is S2-B, already falsified (nonconvex quintic, no strong duality, only weak/supported Pareto = Geoffrion = textbook), and (b) under bottleneck/max-risk the budget subgradient is supported only on the binding agent, so "reallocation across agents" is degenerate and the RCSP needs running-max state augmentation, breaking the clean additive-resource λ-sweep. Claims (i) concave-PL value and (ii) supported-Pareto are NOT broken — but the authors already concede those are textbook, so nothing novel survives the two broken steps.
attacks.is_fatal_or_scoped: FATAL at the claim level — the S2-A MARQUEE/NOVELTY claim must be RETRACTED. Its defining "合取新颖" (single-λ unification + breakpoints certified as homotopy switches) cannot be presented as a novel or certified theorem: it is either unsound (σ-based) or non-novel (full-H-signature = T-MPC++), the unification glue is falsified (S2-B) or bottleneck-degenerate, every component is independently owned (Bemporad/Tøndel, T-MPC++, Dual CC-SSP, IRA/H-PRAP, CP-MPC), and it is not safety-load-bearing (STRIDE firewall). HOWEVER — and this is the honest boundary — this is fatal to the S2-A CLAIM, NOT to the paper: the genuine marquee (S3 + STRIDE, the per-trajectory continuous-time conformal-Bernstein certificate + enumeration-decoupling firewall) is untouched and carries safety on its own. What may be DEMOTED to honest scope (non-marquee, non-theorem, with limitations): an anytime topology-aware search front-end running a λ-sweep over a conformal-priced RCSP, explicitly framed as a combination of mp-LP critical-region search + topology labels + conformal units, with per-candidate safety from S3/STRIDE; plus a heavily-scoped TRUE observation that in the binary-pass / |w_i|≤1 / non-braiding general-position regime the λ-breakpoints coincide with H-signature passing-side switches (but this excludes the dense-crowd headline and is T-MPC++ territory).
attacks.repair_needed: Do NOT attempt to repair S2-A as a novel theorem in Wave7 — it is unrepairable (components all owned; glue unsound-or-falsified; not load-bearing). Required actions: (1) REMOVE S2-A from the marquee/contributions list; relegate to one Methods/System paragraph that openly cites its three owners (Bemporad/Tøndel mp-QP + 2604.07693; T-MPC++ 2401.06021; Dual CC-SSP 2302.13115; IRA/H-PRAP; CP-MPC 2502.06221). (2) DELETE "breakpoint certified as homotopy switch via σ_i flip"; if topology labels are kept at all, use the full space-time H-signature/winding-number (UVD) and attribute to T-MPC++ with NO novelty claim — never present σ-sign as a certificate. (3) DELETE "single-λ unification / certified-risk Pareto staircase"; relabel the λ-sweep output as a HEURISTIC (makespan, risk-SURROGATE) anytime ordering, not a certified-risk frontier; state explicitly that per-agent reallocation is uncertified (S2-B falsified) and degenerate under bottleneck/max-risk (state-augmentation caveat, Wave5 G5). (4) State the σ-lossy limitation: σ is a winding-sign valid only in binary-pass/non-braiding general position; it can both miss real braid/winding-magnitude switches and false-certify discretization artifacts. (5) Move ALL marquee weight to S3 + STRIDE (the firewall is what saves the paper). Net effect on Wave5 status: S2-A drops from "mostly-proven marquee" to "demoted non-novel search component"; theorem count of genuine novel results decreases by one.

attacks.target: S5-F1(reduced-Hessian inertia 语义层路由,单向 sound)+ F2(O(M) matrix-free 二阶 adjoint Hvp)
attacks.attack_summary:
两条都命中,都是"数学正确但不够格当独立贡献"。

S5-F1:去掉所有"首个"后,问题里的预判完全成立——它就是 IPOPT inertia 原语 + 一个 if(ρ>ε)。逐项剥:(a) PD∧stationary⇒严格局部极小 = Nocedal-Wright 二阶充分条件(教科书 Thm 2.4);(b) In(H)=In(D) = Sylvester 惯性定律(1852);(c) BK 后向稳定界 = Bunch-Kaufman(1977),proof 自己写"cited, not re-derived";(d) ρ>ε 整段继承自 S2/S3,本层"does not re-prove ρ";(e)"卡在局部极小就升级到离散/拓扑切换"正是 T-MPC++(2401.06021,T-RO'24)与 local-minima-detection 重规划(1912.12644)的既有范式。剩下被标为"the ONLY new content"的 Lemma C2,其"soundness"是同义反复:把"trigger 的前提被正确检测到"定义成 soundness——谓词在前提成立时被触发本就是定义,不是定理;且 proof 明确 disclaim 了唯一有内容的东西(flip 是否到达安全类)。更狠:产生 PD 证书所需的 H 在仓库根本不存在,部署 solver 是 L-BFGS-B,从不成形 ∇²F。⇒ 无 emergent 数学、无 insight、无 demonstrated benefit,无可发表增量。

adjudication.novelty_after_attack: 在【单条已提交 quintic】上、针对【外生(非反应)障碍 + 多项式/插值运动预测】,我们把 distribution-free split-conformal tube 半径折进【精确连续时间 Bernstein 凸包 deficit】,逐回合(per replan-round)、跨标定抽取边际地认证 P(撞或误分第 i 个被跟踪 agent)≤ε——区别于 moment/SOS 连续时间风险(Jasour,需障碍分布矩)在于 distribution-free,区别于离散步 conformal MPC(Lindemann/Dixit)在于连续时间精确;此为组合新颖,不单挂 sup-over-horizon 或'连续时间'任一单轴。
adjudication.recommendation: 两者都不是——需【novelty 地基局部回炉 + 硬收窄,然后只在收窄实现目标上继续】,且立刻重跑 W1/Boyle 闸门。不要按原 headline 继续锤 W7-W11:原 headline(动态稠密反应人群 / per-track certified / 多条新定理)已死——6 个新原子里 5 个(S2-A、STRIDE、S5-F1、F2、动态域保证)是教科书/被占/未实现,反应域既 unsound(交换性)又被同组 2511.10586 先占,per-track⊥稠密 liveness 是 intrinsic 取舍。但也不必整篇回炉:核心安全数学 sound、S3 窄核活着。所以:(1) 立刻把'弱化一页纸定理'按现状(=S3 窄核:non-reactive、组合、未实现)交 Boyle 裁是否够 RA-L 主线——鉴于被掏空程度,这个闸门很可能返回 NO → 按 spec 既定回退 plan C(per-class MINCO planner side-paper 当主线)。(2) 若 Boyle 放行:最高价值单步=用 interval/rational 算术实现 S3 精确连续时间 conformal-Bernstein deficit 并对 Jasour + Lindemann 在 non-reactive 域 benchmark,把唯一存活原子从'纸面组合'变'demonstrated';同时全文重 frame 成 runtime-safety-filter 系统论文(引 Simplex/RTA/de Groot),贡献='把 distribution-free 语义风险证书挂到 decoupled 执行轨迹上'+FN 三分支/human-hard/Mondrian 集成,而非多定理理论。诚实底线:在实现+benchmark 完成前,S3 窄核只是一个未运行的组合配方,不足以独撑 RA-L 主线。
